item.title: Seattle-based Expedia announces new layoffs affecting 162 employees
item.description: Seattle-based travel company Expedia announced it will lay off more than a hundred employees this spring.

item.title: Microsoft beats Wall Street expectations with $81.3B revenue
item.description: Microsoft reports revenue of $81.3 billion for the October-December quarter, marking a 17% increase from the previous year.

item.title: From Ex-Ram to Seattle hero: Cooper Kupp delivers Super Bowl trip for Seahawks
item.description: Cooper Kupp scored his first home TD as a Seahawk against his former team, the Rams, delivering the game-winner in the NFC Championship to send Seattle back to the Super Bowl.

item.title: As stores and restaurants leave downtown Seattle, there's hope more will return
item.description: Recent reports show office vacancy rates in downtown Seattle are trending upward.

item.title: 7-Eleven lands at SEA Airport, offering 24-hour Slurpees, snacks, more
item.description: The new store is located pre-security near baggage claims 15 and 16, making it available to arriving passengers, airport staff and the public without a boarding pass.

item.title: WA Senate passes bill banning law enforcement face coverings
item.description: A bill aimed at limiting the use of face coverings by law enforcement moved one step closer to becoming law after passing the Washington state Senate following a vote.

item.title: Who's the girl with green hair at the Seattle Seahawks game?
item.description: InfamousKayce is the green-haired, diehard Seattle sports fan with hundreds of thousands of followers who you most likely have seen if you have ever been to the city for a game.

item.title: 3 more kids in Snohomish County, WA test positive for measles
item.description: Snohomish County has confirmed three additional measles cases in children, bringing the total to six during the ongoing outbreak.

item.title: Marysville teenager confirmed as the first pediatric flu death in WA this season
item.description: A young teenager in Marysville died from the flu, marking the first pediatric flu-related death of the 2025-2026 season.

item.title: Leslie scores late tying and go-ahead goals in Charge's 4-2 victory over Torrent
item.description: Rebecca Leslie scored late tying and go-ahead goals to help the Ottawa Charge beat the Seattle Torrent 4-2 on Wednesday night in the final game for both teams before the Olympic break.
